app.name: Socle
app.tagline: Evidence-based strength training for runners and cyclists.

disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Socle suggests exercises for information purposes only. The app does not diagnose and does not replace the advice of a doctor or physiotherapist.
disclaimer.stop: If pain increases, persists or appears at rest, stop the exercises and see a health professional.
disclaimer.data: Your data stays on this device: no account, no server.

perfGoals.sprint-fv: Sprint and force-velocity on the bike

phaseHelp.irritable: Pain is recent or easily flared: we settle it down and keep moving without provoking it.
phaseHelp.rebuild: Pain is stable: we progressively reload to regain strength.
phaseHelp.return-to-sport: Strength is back: we prepare for impact, speed and training volume.

help.strong: Meta-analyses, systematic reviews, several consistent randomised trials or clinical practice guidelines.
help.moderate: At least one good-quality randomised trial.
help.low: Cohort studies, case series or small trials.
help.expert: Common clinical practice without direct evidence.

pro.title: Practitioner mode
pro.subtitle: Build a program for a patient and share it with a link.
pro.step1: Build the sessions from the library, adjust dosage and add your notes.
pro.step2: Generate the link (or QR code) and send it to your patient.
pro.step3: The patient opens the link: the program is saved on their phone.
pro.privacy: Nothing goes through a server: the program lives in the link itself. Avoid writing identifying health data in it.
pro.name: Name shown on your programs
pro.noDrafts: No program yet. Create the first one!
pro.author: Author
pro.notesHint: General instructions, what to do if pain occurs…
pro.intensityHint: Leave empty for the default instruction.
pro.shareHelp: Send this link to your patient (text, email, messaging app) or let them scan the QR code.
pro.shareError: Could not generate the link: check the program.
pro.tooLong: This link is long: some messaging apps may cut it. Prefer the QR code or shorten the notes.
pro.qrAlt: QR code of the share link
pro.sharePrivacy: The link contains the whole program. It goes through no server.
